verdict.rationale: Muse documents persistent personalization: you can name it and shape how it talks (muse-docs-17, muse-docs-2), and its memory about you is stored in the VM where you can inspect and edit it (muse-supp-vm-files-export). The Forget skill also lets you prune what it remembers (muse-docs-12). There is no explicit custom-instructions or preferences feature confirmed to apply to every response. Missing for 10: a documented custom-instructions or system-preference setting, detail on how style and memory edits govern all responses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
